name: BIM Bridge
longDescription: BIM Bridge connects Codex to AutoCAD and Revit on the same Windows PC through an agent-independent runtime. It performs a read-only setup check, installs a per-user host only after explicit approval, discovers structured CAD/BIM tools, previews writes, uses native transaction or undo behavior for bounded changes, and verifies completed work with structured readback and focused visual checks when appropriate.
starterPrompts: Set up BIM Bridge on this PC and verify the local Autodesk connectors.
Inspect the active AutoCAD drawing without changing it.
Create a simple Revit or AutoCAD element, then verify it with structured data and a focused visual check.
